description: Return working Google, Apple and Outlook subscription links and an exact live preview without VenuNite sign-in. Choose up to five interests and fixed 1–50-mile areas; generic MCP supports a different area per interest. This creates no stored account/calendar and does not subscribe a calendar app. Links contain their selected interests and areas; anyone with a link can read them. Changed settings produce a new link. Hosted calls consume request quota and record private telemetry.

audience.description: Default hide excludes family events. Use preference to include them, or only for family-only events. Anonymous feeds have no account preference.

interests.description: An event matches any one interest; conditions within an interest are combined. Keywords match event titles; jazz and trivia also match programming details.

area.description: Override the default area for this interest only, such as Boulder jazz plus Denver comedy.

location.description: An exact center explicitly chosen by the user. Never invent coordinates; omit if unknown.

place.description: Explicit city and state or ZIP for this interest. Never invent coordinates.

radius_miles.description: This interest's fixed radius; defaults to the calendar's radius.

days.description: Venue-local weekdays: Sunday=0 through Saturday=6. Omit for all days.

from.description: Venue-local start window HH:mm. Supply both from and to, or neither.

keyword.description: Keyword or phrase. Empty with an empty category means all event types.

to.description: Exclusive end of start window HH:mm, later than from. Overnight windows need separate interests.

location.description: An exact center explicitly chosen by the user. Never invent coordinates; omit if unknown.

place.description: A city and state or ZIP, for example Boulder, CO or 80302. The user confirms the center in the browser. Omit if unknown.

radius_miles.description: Fixed subscription radius, 1–50 miles. Default is 10; tell the user the radius.

name: create_interest_calendar
title: Create calendar subscription links
